news.title: Microsoft and Google Face a New Bill as Data Centers “Have to Pay Their Own Costs”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysVoters turned against new data centers in the Nov. 3 midterms, and Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta now face rules that make them pay for their own power and grid.
news.title_zh: 微軟與 Google 面臨新帳單，因資料中心「必須自付成本」
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點選民在 Nov. 3 期中選舉中反對新資料中心，微軟、Alphabet、Amazon 和 Meta 現在面臨規定，必須自付電力和電網費用。

news.title: Google Is Spending $17 Billion on a Wyoming Data Center and Says It Will Pay for 100% of Its Power
news.summary: Google just answered the loudest objection to AI data centers, yet the market barely noticed and one key supplier tumbled. The fine print on who supplies the power, and what the pledge leaves out, may matter more than the headline.
news.title_zh: Google 投入 $17 Billion 建設懷俄明州資料中心，並表示將支付 100% 的電力費用
news.summary_zh: Google 剛回應了對 AI 資料中心最大的質疑，但市場幾乎未注意，一家關鍵供應商股價暴跌。關於誰供電的細則，以及承諾未涵蓋的內容，可能比標題更重要。

news.title: Not Alphabet. Not Meta. This Is the Digital Advertising Stock I'd Buy Right Now.
news.summary: Amazon's ad revenue grew 12% last quarter, and management expects high-teens growth next. Here's what's driving it and how the stock is valued.
news.title_zh: 非 Alphabet、非 Meta，這是我現在會買入的數位廣告股票。
news.summary_zh: Amazon 廣告收入上季成長 12%，管理層預期下季將有十幾趴成長。這裡說明驅動因素及股票估值。

news.title: Qualcomm Rises 5% on Alphabet’s $548 Million Stake as CEO Sees a “Disconnect” on AI
news.summary: Key TakeawaysQualcomm shares rose 5% today on Alphabet’s nearly $548 million stake. The stake backs Qualcomm’s data center push, still targeting $5 billion of revenue in fiscal 2027.
news.title_zh: Qualcomm 上漲 5%，因 Alphabet 持股 $548 Million，CEO 看到 AI 上的「脫節」
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點 Qualcomm 股價今日上漲 5%，因 Alphabet 持有近 $548 million 股權。該股權支持 Qualcomm 推進資料中心，仍以財年 2027 達到 $5 billion 營收為目標。

news.title: A $25 Billion Fund Just Bought These 3 Stocks
news.summary: Key TakeawaysA $25 billion fund made Nokia (NOK), Qualcomm (QCOM:NASDAQ), and Alphabet (GOOGL:NASDAQ) its three biggest new or added positions in Q3. All three stocks have fallen since Sept.
news.title_zh: 一家 $25 Billion 基金剛買入這些 3 股票
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要一家 $25 billion 基金將 Nokia (NOK)、Qualcomm (QCOM:NASDAQ) 和 Alphabet (GOOGL:NASDAQ) 列為其在 Q3 的三大新增或加碼部位。這三檔股票自 Sept. 以來皆下跌。

news.title: TeraWulf Rises 4% After Q3 Beat and Google-Backed Anthropic Lease; IREN Surges 17%, Cipher Digital Climbs 6%
news.summary: TeraWulf beat Wall Street's estimates and landed a Google safety net for its Anthropic lease, yet it still trails its rivals in the AI hosting bounce. What hides behind the headline numbers, and why does its landlord model lag when the rally hits?
news.title_zh: TeraWulf 上漲 4%，因 Q3 超預期及 Google 支持的 Anthropic 租約；IREN 飆升 17%，Cipher Digital 上漲 6%
news.summary_zh: TeraWulf 擊敗華爾街預期，並為其 Anthropic 租約獲得 Google 的安全網，但仍落後於 AI 託管反彈中的競爭對手。標題數字背後隱藏什麼？為何其房東模式在反彈時滯後？

news.title: Apple Vs. Alphabet: The Midterms Just Separated Them from The Mag 7 Pack
news.summary: One company banks record profits while the other burns cash and issues stock to build its future. After a week of earnings and election relief, the market sees them very differently, and one valuation gap looks hard to ignore.
news.title_zh: Apple 對決 Alphabet：期中選舉剛將它們從 Mag 7 群組中分開
news.summary_zh: 一家公司錄得創紀錄利潤，而另一家則燒錢並發行股票以建設未來。在財報與選舉緩解的一週後，市場對它們的看法截然不同，且一個估值缺口似乎難以忽視。

news.title: Alphabet is The Best Positioned Hyperscaler for This Blue Wave AI-Energy Regulation Shift
news.summary: Democrats now control Congress, voters are rejecting data centers, and AI stocks are sliding as power bills become a political weapon. One hyperscaler has the balance sheet, the chips, and the valuation to absorb the blow, and it is not the one most investors expect.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 是此藍色浪潮 AI-能源監管轉變中定位最佳的超大規模雲端服務商
news.summary_zh: 民主黨現在控制國會，選民拒絕資料中心，隨著電費帳單成為政治武器，AI 股票下滑。一家超大規模雲端服務商擁有資產負債表、晶片和估值來承受衝擊，而它並非大多數投資者預期的那一家。

news.title: Alphabet: TPU Sales And Gemini Enterprise Are Reshaping The Bull Case
news.summary: Alphabet Inc. is rated a Buy due to rapid progress in its Gemini Enterprise and TPU system sales businesses. Read more on GOOG stock here.
news.title_zh: Alphabet：TPU 銷售與 Gemini Enterprise 正重塑看漲論點
news.summary_zh: Alphabet Inc. 因其 Gemini Enterprise 和 TPU 系統銷售業務快速進展而被評為買進。詳情請參閱 GOOG 股票。

news.title: Oracle vs. Alphabet: Which Is the Better AI Cloud Stock to Own for the Next 5 Years?
news.summary: Both companies are in the middle of an AI spending spree, but Alphabet's prominent position in cloud computing gives it the edge.
news.title_zh: Oracle 對決 Alphabet：未來 5 年哪檔是更好的 AI 雲端股票？
news.summary_zh: 兩家公司都處於 AI 支出熱潮中，但 Alphabet 在雲端運算的顯著地位使其佔優。

news.title: Cathie Wood Sells $12.8 Million Of Alphabet, Days After The Stock Suffered Its Worst Day Since Its 2004 IPO, Losing Nearly Half A Trillion Dollars In Market Value

news.title: Google could take stake in TeraWulf’s $19B AI project
news.summary: Google has agreed to backstop Anthropic’s $19 billion lease at bitcoin miner TeraWulf’s Kentucky data center. If Anthropic defaults, Google can take over the lease or take a stake in the project. Plus, Payward purchases AAVE tokens and Standard Chartered’s venture arm invests in Soter. CoinDesk’s Jennifer Sanasie hosts “CoinDesk Daily.” - This episode is brought to you by Grayscale, the world's largest digital asset-focused investment platform. Grayscale's mission is to make digital asset investing simple and open to every investor. Learn more at grayscale.com.
news.title_zh: Google 可能參與 TeraWulf 的 $19B AI 專案
news.summary_zh: Google 同意為 Anthropic 在比特幣礦商 TeraWulf 位於肯塔基州的數據中心的 $19 billion 租約提供擔保。若 Anthropic 違約，Google 可接管租約或參與該專案。此外，Payward 購買 AAVE 代幣，渣打銀行的風投部門投資 Soter。CoinDesk 的 Jennifer Sanasie 主持「CoinDesk Daily」。- 本集由 Grayscale 贊助，全球最大的數位資產專注投資平台。Grayscale 的使命是讓數位資產投資變得簡單，向每位投資者開放。詳情請見 grayscale.com。

news.title: Nvidia’s Chinese Clients Will Get Just 1% of $70 Billion in RTX Chip Orders
news.summary: Key TakeawaysChinese AI and cloud firms, Alibaba among them, have ordered about 6 million NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 chips worth about $70 billion, but expect to get only about 1% of them over the next four months. With too little capacity to go around, NVIDIA is building its most advanced, higher-margin chips first, so China’s orders are left waiting.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要中國 AI 與雲端企業（包括阿里巴巴）已訂購約 6 million 顆 NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 晶片，價值約 $70 billion，但預期未來四個月僅能獲得其中約 1%。因產能不足，NVIDIA 優先生產最先進、利潤較高的晶片，導致中國訂單被迫等待。

news.title: Elon Musk's Tesla to 'wind down' Cybertruck production next year
news.summary: Musk said the decision was taken in order to make room for increased production of its Cybercab robotaxi. The move comes after years of weaker-than-expected sales for the futuristic electric pickup.View on euronews

news.summary_zh: Musk 表示,此決定是為了騰出空間增加 Cybercab 自駕計程車的產量。此舉是在這款未來感電動皮卡銷售多年低於預期後出現的。View on euronews

news.title: SpaceX Soars 6% as AI Stocks Rebound From $420 Billion Post-Midterm Musk Selloff
news.summary: Key TakeawaysSpaceX shares jumped 6% today as AI stocks rebounded, with Credo Technology and Astera Labs also rising, after a two-day selloff that cost SpaceX and Tesla over $420 billion of market value. The bounce looks like dip-buying: SpaceX had no news of its own, and the risks behind the drop are still in place.
news.title_zh: SpaceX 飆升 6%, AI 股票從 $420 Billion 期中選舉後 Musk 拋售中反彈
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要SpaceX 股價今日跳升 6%,隨著 AI 股票反彈,Credo Technology 和 Astera Labs 也上漲,此前兩天拋售導致 SpaceX 和 Tesla 損失超過 $420 billion 市值。反彈看起來像是逢低買入:SpaceX 沒有自己的消息,導致下跌的風險仍然存在。

news.title: Musk Winds Down Cybertruck to Make Room for “Increased Cybercab Production”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at Gigafactory Texas around mid-2027 to make room for more Cybercab output. The “other models” line that includes the truck was under 2% of third-quarter deliveries.
news.title_zh: Musk 逐步停產 Cybertruck 以騰出空間「增加 Cybercab 產量」

news.summary: Elon Musk said production at Tesla's Texas factory will be reduced around the middle of next year as the company shifts resources toward fully autonomous vehicles.

news.title: SpaceX Rises 4% as Tech Stocks Rebound From Post-Election Rout; AST SpaceMobile Sinks 8%, Rocket Lab Gains 2%
news.summary: After a brutal midterm selloff, SpaceX is clawing back ground while one space rival keeps sliding. Between Washington scrutiny, a looming Tesla merger vote, and a record-high cost to insure its debt, the bounce faces real tests.

news.summary_zh: 經歷慘烈的期中選舉拋售後，SpaceX 正在收復失地，而一家太空競爭對手持續下滑。在華盛頓的審視、即將到來的特斯拉合併投票，以及創紀錄的債務保險成本之間，這波反彈面臨真正考驗。

news.title: Costco Stock: Earnings Growth Could Shape the Next Big Move
news.summary: Six straight earnings beats have pushed Costco shares up 20% this year, yet a 49x trailing P/E leaves little room for error. One metric could decide whether the rally keeps running or finally stalls.

news.title: ‘Only Go Into Physical Stores Every Sixth Week’: Clark Howard’s Anti-Impulse Rule as Costco Hits $1,025
news.summary: Clark Howard spent years watching couples bleed money one warehouse trip at a time, and the fix he landed on sounds almost too simple to work. With Costco shares surging past $1,000 and the holiday treasure-hunt season starting, the math behind his rule gets uncomfortable fast.

news.summary_zh: 克拉克·霍華德花了多年觀察情侶們一次倉儲式購物就大出血，他找到的對策聽起來簡單得幾乎不像會奏效。隨著 Costco 股價衝過 $1,000，假日尋寶季啟動，他規則背後的數學算起來讓人很不舒服。

news.title: In 1975, Sol Price Was Pushed Out of FedMart, the Discount Chain He Founded. The Warehouse Store He Opened Next Became Part of Costco
news.summary: A lawyer-turned-retailer got fired from the discount chain he built over two decades, and the warehouse he opened next with a handful of friends and a converted Hughes property became the blueprint for one of the most powerful retail businesses on the planet.
news.title_zh: 在 1975 年，Sol Price 被踢出他創辦的折扣連鎖 FedMart。他接著開設的倉儲店後來成為 Costco 的一部分
news.summary_zh: 這位從律師轉行的零售商，從他經營了二十多年的折扣連鎖店被解僱，隨後他和幾位朋友利用一處改建的 Hughes 房產開設的倉儲店，成了全球最強大零售企業之一的藍圖。

news.title: Jim Cramer Says Costco Is Still a Great Value. Charlie Munger’s Rule Explains Why
news.summary: Charlie Munger once said Costco is the one stock where you can look past the P/E. After a month-long rally, that exception faces its toughest test yet, and the business and the price may tell two different stories.

news.summary_zh: 查理·芒格曾說 Costco 是那檔可以不看本益比的股票。經過一個月的漲勢後，這個例外面臨迄今最嚴峻的考驗，基本面與股價可能講述兩個截然不同的故事。

news.title: Costco retains BofA "buy" as October US comps rise 8.1%

US comparable sales excluding gasoline price changes rose 8.1%, with growth improving from September on both a year-over-year and two-year...

news.summary_zh: Costco Wholesale Corporation (NASDAQ:COST, XETRA:CTO) 美國同店銷售在十月加速增長，促使美銀維持其「買入」評級。扣除汽油價格變動的美國同店銷售上升 8.1%，增長較九月改善，無論按年增長還是兩年...

news.title: Apple Is Virtually Insulated From Blue-Wave Pain Points

news.title: Forget Nvidia. Here’s the Company Behind the Chips
news.summary: Every AI chip from Nvidia and Broadcom runs through one company's fabs, yet that company trades at a fraction of the valuation its customers command. The gap raises a question worth answering before the market closes it.
news.title_zh: 別再盯著 Nvidia。這是晶片背後的關鍵公司
news.summary_zh: Nvidia 和 Broadcom 的每顆 AI 晶片都經過同一家公司的晶圓廠生產，但該公司的估值僅為其客戶的幾分之一。這個落差引出一個值得在市場填補前回答的問題。

news.title: Cathie Wood Is Buying The Dip In Nvidia As She Adds $45.9 Million Of NVDA And Sells $119.7 Million Of Broadcom
news.summary: ARK bet on one AI chip giant and dumped another on the same brutal selloff day. A midterm shock, data center politics, and a surprising Friday rebound make the swap harder to read than it looks.
news.title_zh: Cathie Wood 在 Nvidia 下跌時買入，增持 $45.9 Million NVDA 並賣出 $119.7 Million Broadcom
news.summary_zh: ARK 在同一天慘烈拋售中押注一家 AI 晶片巨頭，拋售另一家。中期選舉衝擊、資料中心政治博弈，以及令人意外的週五反彈，讓這次調倉比表面看起來更難解讀。

news.title: Cathie Wood Just Dumped $134 Million of Broadcom and Bought Nvidia and SpaceX
news.summary: The market's ugliest session in years pushed ARK to rotate a huge chunk of its AI bet, and Broadcom's numbers look nothing like its stock chart. What does Cathie Wood's team see in the other two names that it no longer sees here?
news.title_zh: Cathie Wood 才剛拋售 $134 Million Broadcom 並買入 Nvidia 和 SpaceX
news.summary_zh: 多年來最醜陋的市場交易時段迫使 ARK 轉移其 AI 押注的大筆部位，Broadcom 的基本面數據與其股價走勢完全脫節。Cathie Wood 團隊在另外兩檔股票看到了什麼，而不再在這裡看到？

news.title: Broadcom Stock Has Had Only 2 Losing Years Since 2009. 2026 Is on Pace to Be the 3rd.
news.summary: After the last two, the stock rose 24% and then almost doubled. Can it rebound like that again?
news.title_zh: Broadcom 股票自 2009 以來僅有 2 年下跌。2026 有望成為第 3rd 年。
news.summary_zh: 在過去兩次之後，股價上漲 24%，隨後幾乎翻倍。它能再次像那樣反彈嗎？

news.title: Prediction: November Will Be a Huge Month for Broadcom
news.summary: Broadcom could be one of the best stocks to own over the next few years.
news.title_zh: 預測：十一月將是 Broadcom 的重要月份
news.summary_zh: Broadcom 可能是未來幾年最值得持有的股票之一。

news.title: Broadcom Sinks 9% as AI Regulation Fears Deepen Chip Rout
news.summary: Key TakeawaysBroadcom fell 9% today on fears that Democrats’ midterm wins will slow US data center building. Analysts expect Broadcom’s normalized EPS to nearly triple from fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027.
news.title_zh: Broadcom 下跌 9% 隨著 AI 監管恐懼加深晶片拋售潮
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Broadcom 今日下跌 9% 擔心民主黨中期選舉獲勝將減緩美國資料中心建設。分析師預期 Broadcom 經常性 EPS 將從財政年度 2025 到財政年度 2027 近乎翻三倍。

news.title: Broadcom Stock Could Be Approaching a Major Turning Point. Here’s the Price Target
news.summary: Broadcom's share price keeps falling while its AI revenue explodes to record highs, and that widening gap between fundamentals and stock performance rarely lasts long before something gives.
news.title_zh: Broadcom 股價可能正接近重大轉折點。這是目標價
news.summary_zh: Broadcom 股價持續下跌，而其 AI 營收激增至歷史新高，基本面與股價表現之間不斷擴大的差距很少能長久維持，終將出現變化。

news.title: Is Broadcom Stock a Buy After Marvell's $115 Billion Deal?
news.summary: A rival chipmaker is buying a big laser maker. Is the AI chip giant's stock, around 30% under its record, still worth buying?
news.title_zh: Marvell 達成 $115 Billion 交易後，Broadcom 股票值得買進嗎？
news.summary_zh: 一家競爭對手晶片製造商正收購一家大型雷射製造商。這家 AI 晶片巨頭的股票，距離歷史高點約 30%，仍值得買進嗎？

news.title: Is Broadcom Stock a Buy Now?
news.summary: Broadcom beat its own AI target and guided higher, yet the stock has lagged.
news.title_zh: 現在買進 Broadcom 股票值得嗎？
news.summary_zh: Broadcom 超越自身 AI 目標並上調展望，股價卻表現落後。

news.title: Nvidia is Far From The Only Threat to AMD
news.summary: Intel just posted its strongest data center growth in 15 years, and Broadcom is pulling AI budgets toward custom chips that undercut GPU pricing. AMD is fighting a two-front war it rarely gets credit for.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 遠非 AMD 唯一威脅
news.summary_zh: Intel 剛公布 15 年來最強資料中心成長，而 Broadcom 正將 AI 預算拉向價格低於 GPU 的客製化晶片。AMD 正在進行一場鮮少獲得認可的兩線作戰。

news.title: Buy the Dip or Wait? Three Scenarios That Could Shape Broadcom Stock Through 2028
news.summary: Broadcom's AI chip revenue is surging at a triple-digit pace while the stock trades near its 52-week low, and the gap between Wall Street's target and one analyst model's projection runs to hundreds of dollars per share. Three scenarios map out exactly what has to go right, and what breaks the thesis, through 2028.
news.title_zh: 逢低買進還是觀望？三大情境可能塑造 Broadcom 股價走勢至 2028
news.summary_zh: Broadcom AI 晶片營收以三位數速度激增，股價卻在 52 週低點附近交易，華爾街目標價與某分析師模型預測之差距達每股數百美元。三大情境精確描繪什麼必須順利、什麼會擊碎投資論點，直至 2028。

news.title: Broadcom vs. Taiwan Semiconductor: Two AI Powerhouses, but One Offers a Better Value for 2027
news.summary: Broadcom and Taiwan Semiconductor are two major beneficiaries of the AI boom, but their contrasting valuations and business models could make one a more compelling investment.
news.title_zh: 博通 vs. 台積電：兩大 AI 強權，但其中一家提供更好的價值給 2027
news.summary_zh: 博通和台積電是 AI 熱潮的兩大受益者，但它們截然不同的估值和商業模式可能讓其中一家成為更具吸引力的投資標的。

news.title: Coherent Soars 13% as Citi Lifts Target to $440, Lumentum Up 3% in AI Optics Rebound
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent jumped 13% today after Citi raised its target to $440, and Lumentum and Marvell bounced too. Wall Street is split on Coherent’s quarter: Citi and Stifel raised their targets, while BofA and others cut theirs.
news.title_zh: Coherent 飆升 13% 隨著 花旗上調目標價至 $440，Lumentum 上漲 3% 於 AI 光學反彈中
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Coherent 於今日跳升 13%，此前花旗上調目標價至 $440，Lumentum 與 Marvell 也同樣反彈。華爾街對 Coherent 本季表現意見分歧：花旗與 Stifel 上調目標價，而美銀（BofA）等則下調。

news.title: Marvell Is Betting $115 Billion on 1 of AI's Biggest Bottlenecks
news.summary: The chipmaker is paying a premium price to protect its biggest business.
news.title_zh: Marvell 押注 $115 Billion 於 1，針對 AI 最大瓶頸
news.summary_zh: 晶片製造商支付溢價以保護其核心業務。

news.title: Marvell Rises 4%, AMD Up 10% as Chip Stocks Rebound From Election Selloff
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell rose 4% today as chip stocks, AMD and NVIDIA among them, bounced back from Thursday’s election selloff. The bounce undoes only the election part of Marvell’s slide: its all-stock Lumentum deal still weighs on the stock.
news.title_zh: Marvell 上漲 4%, AMD 上漲 10%, 晶片股從大選拋售中反彈
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Marvell 今日上漲 4%, 晶片股(包括 AMD 和 NVIDIA)從週四的大選拋售中反彈。這波反彈僅抵銷 Marvell 跌幅中與大選相關的部分:其全股票交易的 Lumentum 併購案仍拖累股價。

news.title: Marvell Drops 50% in One Month: This Analyst Stands Pat on 195% Gains Prediction
news.summary: Marvell's own all-stock acquisition triggered the steepest slide among AI chip peers, yet not a single analyst has issued a Sell. One Wall Street firm sees the selloff as a misread of the deal's structure. Will the integration prove it right?
news.title_zh: Marvell 一個月內下跌 50%：這位分析師堅持 195% 漲幅預測
news.summary_zh: Marvell 自己的全股票收購引發 AI 晶片同業中最陡峭的下跌，但沒有一位分析師發布賣出評級。一家華爾街公司認為這波拋售是對交易結構的誤讀。整合能否證明其正確？

news.title: Prediction: The Next Big AI Stock Winner Could Be Hiding in Plain Sight
news.summary: Marvell just raised its outlook while shareholders sprinted for the exits, and a blockbuster all-stock deal is the likely trigger. Why would a business this strong get punished, and who stands to profit when panic outruns fundamentals?
news.title_zh: 預測：下一檔大型 AI 股票贏家可能就藏在顯而易見之處
news.summary_zh: Marvell 剛上調展望，股東卻爭相出逃，一筆大型全股票交易極可能是觸發因素。為何這麼強的企業會受罰，當恐慌超越基本面時，誰將獲利？

news.title: Marvell Agreed to Pay $1,132 a Share for Lumentum. The Stock Trades Near $510. Here's Why It’s Not as Good As It Looks.
news.summary: The gap between Lumentum's stock price and Marvell's offer looks like easy money. It isn't.
news.title_zh: Marvell 同意以每股 $1,132 收購 Lumentum。股價交易於 $510 附近。這裡說明為何不如表面那麼美好。
news.summary_zh: Lumentum 股價與 Marvell 出價之間的差距看似輕鬆獲利。並非如此。

news.title: Marvell’s Lumentum Deal Is “Dangerously Myopic.” Lumentum Is Down 25% in Two Days
news.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell 18. 7% to $510 on Thursday, and Marvell’s own slide cut the all-stock deal’s value to about $601 a share from $1,132.
news.title_zh: Marvell 的 Lumentum 交易「極度短視」。Lumentum 兩天下跌 25%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Lumentum 下跌 18。7% 至 $510 於週四，且 Marvell 自身下滑將全股票交易價值削減至約 $601 每股，從 $1,132。

news.title: What Insight Enterprises (NSIT) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
news.summary: Insight Enterprises (NASDAQ:NSIT) reported 22% revenue growth in the third quarter of 2026 and raised its full-year outlook, as demand for infrastructure hardware, cloud services and devices helped the technology solutions provider exceed its expectations. Revenue for the quarter ended September 30
news.title_zh: Insight Enterprises (NSIT) 在其 Q3 財報電話會上說了什麼
news.summary_zh: Insight Enterprises (NASDAQ:NSIT) 報告 22% 營收成長於 2026 第三季，並上調全年展望，因基礎設施硬體、雲端服務和裝置需求幫助這家技術解決方案供應商超越預期。截至 September 30 止的季度營收

news.title: Why Marvell Stock Is Falling Today
news.summary: Marvell is getting hit twice: investors are fleeing AI data center stocks after the midterms, and its all-stock Lumentum deal could mean significant dilution.
news.title_zh: 為何 Marvell 股價今日下跌
news.summary_zh: Marvell 雙重受創：投資人在期中選舉後逃離 AI 資料中心股票，且其全股票交易的 Lumentum 交易可能意味著顯著稀釋。

news.title: Marvell Just Dropped 49% in a Month: Is MRVL Stock Hopeless or Ready for a Rebound?
news.summary: Marvell's results keep improving, yet its shares have been gutted by an all-stock acquisition and an election night shock for AI spending. Two analysts looked at the same deal and reached opposite verdicts, and the gap between them is huge.
news.title_zh: Marvell 一個月內暴跌 49%：MRVL 股票是無望還是準備好反彈了？
news.summary_zh: Marvell 的業績持續改善，但其股價因全股票收購和 AI 支出的選舉之夜衝擊而遭重創。兩位分析師看同一筆交易卻得出相反結論，兩者之間的差距極大。

news.title: Lumentum Sinks 15% as AI Chip Selloff Deepens
news.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell 15% today as the AI selloff deepened. Marvell is paying for Lumentum in stock with no price protection, so Lumentum trades on Marvell’s shares.
news.title_zh: Lumentum 下跌 15%，隨著 AI 晶片拋售加劇
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Lumentum 今日下跌 15%，隨著 AI 拋售加劇。Marvell 以股票支付 Lumentum 且無價格保護，因此 Lumentum 隨 Marvell 股價波動。

news.title: Marvell Sinks Another 14% as Democratic Sweep Deepens AI Chip Selloff
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell Technology fell another 14% today in the post-election AI selloff. Marvell is paying for its pending optical deal in stock, so each dollar its shares lose takes $4.
news.title_zh: Marvell 再度下跌 14%，民主黨大勝加深 AI 晶片拋售
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Marvell Technology 今日在選後 AI 拋售潮中再度下跌 14%。Marvell 以股票支付其待定的光學交易，因此每損失一美元股價就會 $4。
